ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$1.13 to the rider as a Ryde voucher for the unexempted detour mileage; note the RD-1 breach on the driver's record (no account flag — no upheld route dispute in the last 90 days).

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 22:57–23:01 added 0.80 km. No RD-4(a) traffic incident on the replaced optimal-route stretch (F14); the AYE speed-band record (F11) is only corroborative under RD-4(b) and cannot exempt alone. No rider consent before the detour began — the pre-detour chat is only about pickup (F7, F8) and the driver's post-trip 'AYE was crawling' statement (F10) is a claim, not consent under RD-5/G11. Segment is unexempted under RD-1.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's claim of severe AYE congestion does not exempt the segment: RD-4 requires a traffic incident (Accident/Roadwork/etc.) on the replaced optimal-route stretch within 300 m, and F14 records none. A speed band alone (F11) is only corroborative, and it is not matched to the optimal route for the detour window.
The full +1.6 km / $2.33 excess is not refunded: RD-2 refunds only the unexempted segment mileage; the residual 0.8 km is map-matching/meter difference and is not refundable.
